methodology_note: Numerator: AISHE 2021-22 enrolment. Denominator: Census 2011 C-15 population (15-19 + 20-24) × 0.6 as an 18-23 proxy (single-year-age table not pulled). Published national GER 2021-22 = 28.4% (MoSPI projected denominator); our 2011-denominator computation sits ~2-3pp above due to projection vs Census gap. The Muslim-vs-national gap is the story and is robust to the choice of denominator. Total enrolment 4,32,68,181 from AISHE 2021-22 Report p29 prose. Muslim enrolment = sum of state-level rows from Table 15. Muslim numerator: 2,108,033; Muslim 18-23 proxy: 21,445,159.
